name: AI Lens
heroCopy:
Real innovation. Beyond the known.
A vision of the future.

hero.alt: Woman wearing glasses and looking out of a car window

feature.alt: Woman wearing AI Lens among blurred figures

gallery.alt: Woman in a green dress walking outdoors

technologyTitle:
Comfort and natural vision from the very first use.
The first progressive lens designed with artificial intelligence.
technologyDescription:
Novar AiLens© is the result of the latest global technological innovation, designed to go beyond what is currently known. It optimizes the lens to help you see the world with fewer peripheral limits.

Novar©’s exclusive, revolutionary AI-GET technology uses artificial intelligence to design progressive lenses with optical qualities that surpass those created by other methods.

callouts.text: Designed to provide smooth vision at every distance.
Thanks to its advanced technology, it reduces the feeling of swaying.
Ideal for people who spend a lot of time in front of screens.

technologySummary: An exclusive Novar technology that combines advanced optics and visual neuroscience to create lenses that adapt to how you see the world. The result: more natural, comfortable, clear vision with every glance.
galleryCaption:
Enjoy the world
with clarity so natural,
as if you were not wearing lenses.

questions.question: What is Novar AI·Lens?
questions.answer: It is a progressive lens designed with artificial intelligence for an advanced visual experience.

questions.question: Who is it recommended for?
questions.answer: For people seeking a premium progressive lens that is comfortable, fluid, and highly adaptable.

questions.question: What makes it different?
questions.answer: The combination of Psicoptix and AI-GET optimizes the design and enhances the visual experience at every distance.

name: MyoLens
heroCopy:
A new generation
of lenses for people with myopia.

hero.alt: Two young people wearing clear glasses outdoors

feature.alt: Close-up of a young person wearing MyoLens

technologyTitle: A single-vision lens developed with artificial intelligence to optimize myopia correction in the central visual field.
technologyDescription: Novar MyoLens is designed for people with myopia who want clear central vision and greater comfort. It combines Psicoptix and AI-GET to compensate for peripheral overcorrection and improve visual perception.

callouts.text: A comfort-focused single-vision lens for myopia.
Greater visual stability for people with myopia
Optimized central correction and peripheral comfort.

technologySummary: AI-GET and Psicoptix work in the lens design to optimize central vision and compensate for peripheral effects, creating a more comfortable experience for people with myopia.

questions.question: What is MyoLens?
questions.answer: It is a single-vision lens designed to improve the visual experience for people with myopia.

questions.question: Who is it recommended for?
questions.answer: For people with myopia seeking central correction and greater visual comfort.

questions.question: What makes it different?
questions.answer: Its AI-based design and focus on peripheral compensation.

questions.question: Is it the same as MyoFix?
questions.answer: No. MyoFix is intended for myopia management in children and adolescents. MyoLens is designed to provide greater visual comfort for people with myopia.

name: AIWork

hero.alt: Professional wearing glasses and working on a laptop

feature.alt: Two professionals wearing glasses and working in an office

gallery.alt: Professional wearing glasses in front of a computer and screens

technologyTitle: An occupational lens designed with artificial intelligence for professionals who need visual precision in multitasking and digital environments.
technologyDescription: Designed for modern work, combining technology and artificial intelligence to optimize the experience with screens, documents, and precision tasks. More than a traditional occupational lens, AIWORK adapts vision at intermediate and near distances to support greater comfort, concentration, and visual performance for professionals seeking productivity in digital workplaces.

callouts.text: Its algorithms adapt the design to each user’s working distances and visual needs, helping reduce eye strain.
More comfort at the distances you use throughout your workday.
Designed for offices, studios, screens, meetings, and multitasking routines.
Optimized performance for near, intermediate, and extended vision.

technologySummary: AI-GET optimizes the design based on the user’s visual needs and working distances, improving precision, comfort, and fluidity.
galleryCaption:
Visual precision at near,
intermediate, and extended distances.

questions.question: What is MyoFix?
questions.answer: It is a lens designed to support myopia management in children and adolescents.

questions.question: Who is it recommended for?
questions.answer: For children and adolescents with progressive myopia, always under professional guidance and follow-up.

questions.question: Does it replace professional follow-up?
questions.answer: No. Follow-up with an eye-care professional is essential for proper adaptation and monitoring.

questions.question: What makes it different?
questions.answer: Its combination of central correction and controlled peripheral defocus.
